workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic verification of the authoritative Analysis prompt SHA-256, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and verified Worker Claimed. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-16 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260816-01 concludes that durable human-in-the-loop authorization should separate broad default policy, an occurrence-scoped exception, actor/authority evidence and external-effect evidence; exact-call persistence establishes a narrow resumable decision but not approver identity or exactly-once effects. Q-20260816-02 concludes that pre-materialization orchestration should separate reserved stable identity, bounded pending host intent, authoritative materialization and abandonment/reconciliation cleanup; reservation is correlation rather than proof of object existence, and the selected Codex mechanism is local rather than a distributed reservation transaction. Q-20260816-03 concludes that deterministic configuration precedence resolves which value wins but not provenance or authorization; raw escape hatches are safer when later execution-owned settings retain explicit precedence and security-sensitive effective values can be traced to their source layer. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Analysis Prompt SHA-256 的确定性核验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-16 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260816-01 的判断是：持久化 Human-in-the-loop Authorization 应分离宽泛 Default Policy、Occurrence-scoped Exception、Actor/Authority Evidence 与 External-effect Evidence；Exact-call Persistence 建立的是窄范围、可恢复的决定，而不是 Approver Identity 或 Exactly-once Effect。Q-20260816-02 的判断是：Pre-materialization Orchestration 应分离 Reserved Stable Identity、有限 Pending Host Intent、Authoritative Materialization 与 Abandonment/Reconciliation Cleanup；Reservation 是 Correlation，而不是 Object Existence 的证明，且所选 Codex 机制是本地实现，不是分布式 Reservation Transaction。Q-20260816-03 的判断是：Deterministic Configuration Precedence 解决的是哪个值获胜，而不是 Provenance 或 Authorization；Raw Escape Hatch 更安全的前提是更晚的 Execution-owned Setting 保持明确优先级，并且安全相关 Effective Value 能追溯 Source Layer。未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Durable authorization should preserve a broad default and a narrow occurrence-scoped exception while keeping actor/authority evidence and effect evidence separate; persistence of the exact decision does not prove approver identity or exactly-once external execution.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 持久化 Authorization 应同时保留宽泛 Default 与窄范围 Occurrence-scoped Exception，并把 Actor/Authority Evidence、Effect Evidence 分离；Exact Decision 的持久化不能证明 Approver Identity 或外部 Exactly-once Execution。

researchObjects.judgment: Pre-materialization coordination should distinguish reserved identity, pending host intent, authoritative materialization and cleanup/reconciliation; a reservation provides correlation but is not proof that the object exists.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Pre-materialization Coordination 应区分 Reserved Identity、Pending Host Intent、Authoritative Materialization 与 Cleanup/Reconciliation；Reservation 提供 Correlation，但不是对象已经存在的证明。

researchObjects.judgment: Deterministic configuration precedence defines conflict resolution, not authorization; robust multi-layer configuration should also expose provenance for security-relevant effective values and preserve explicit ownership of later execution-scoped settings.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Deterministic Configuration Precedence 定义的是冲突解析，而不是 Authorization；稳健的多层配置还应暴露安全相关 Effective Value 的 Provenance，并保留更晚 Execution-scoped Setting 的显式 Ownership。
